This 2021 BMW 540i M Sport Just Sold for $26,750 and It's Probably a Best-Buy
19 photos
Photo: Bring a Trailer
I think I'm being as objective as possible when I tell you that you're looking at peak executive sedan here. Not just regarding something with a BMW badge, but in general. You won't find this combination of driving dynamics and interior build quality in anything else from this segment. Not in the newer G60 5 Series, and certainly not in anything with an Audi or Mercedes badge.
I'll admit that the latest E-Class, the W214, is best-in-class when it comes to comfort, but that's always been the case with Mercedes. You know what you're getting, and it depends on which factors matter most to you. But from a driver's perspective, the G30 5 Series is about as good as it gets.
Regarding this car here, the spec is almost identical to my own - except I have a 530i not a 540i, but the model year is the same and so are tons of other things available on this car, such as the M Sport brakes, the M Sport package, M Sport suspension, the seats, and so on. When new, this car retailed for roughly $70,000, and someone just bought it at auction for $26,750 with 86,340 miles (139,000 km) on the clock.
According to the ad, the coolant, brake fluid and engine oil were all serviced back in August of this year, which means this is about as safe a buy as you can find - mileage be damned. These are extremely reliable drivetrains (the B58 / 8-speed auto combo) and the fact that this car is rear-wheel drive (no xDrive system) makes it all the more safe since you don't have to worry about maintenance for the transfer case.
Aside from its Bernina Gray Amber Effect colorway, this 540i also comes with the Shadowline trim, LED headlights, a power tailgate, sunroof, M Sport bumpers and side skirts (courtesy of the M Sport package), plus a set of Jet Black 19" Style 845M wheels with 245/40 front and 275/35 rear Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires. So far, it's identical to mine (wheels included), except mine has the Carbon Black Metallic exterior.
Photo: Bring a Trailer Moving along to the interior, highlights include the black perforated SensaTec upholstery, Pearl Chrome accents, heated front seats, wireless charging, a 16-speaker Harman Kardon surround sound system, Gesture Control, wireless charging for your mobile device, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, a head-up display, the configurable Live Cockpit Pro gauge cluster, and more.
What's worth keeping in mind about the G30 is that the wireless charging tray isn't particularly large. You can fit a normal iPhone 18 Pro, or something like the iPhone Air. But it's a tight squeeze. The 17 Pro Max and 18 Pro Max? Not a chance. They don't fit.
As for the engine, the B58 is a masterpiece. It's a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six unit, rated at 335 horsepower and 332 lb-ft of torque. Everything gets sent to the rear wheels via an eight-speed automatic transmission.
